objective: Measure train-before/evaluate-after classifier behavior on outcomes that were unknown when predictions were persisted, without relabeling retrospective scores as prospective evidence.

readiness_assessment.reason: Only the OPT-002 Documenso/Lobsters wave has compatible scores frozen before human outcomes. Earlier compatible labels were already known before their compatible scores were persisted and are retrospective evidence, not train-before/evaluate-after observations.

temporal_identity.prediction_precedes_review: triage_score.scored_at must be earlier than the first authoritative assessment/label timestamp for the exact finding identity
temporal_identity.training_cutoff: Every model-training label must have an authoritative timestamp strictly earlier than the frozen model build and prediction wave
temporal_identity.immutable_prediction: Persist model name, version, feature schema, calibration, training-label identity digest, score, and score timestamp before packet selection or review
temporal_identity.outcome_blinding: Packet selection and reviewers may not receive score, rank, predicted class, expected outcome, or threshold classification
temporal_identity.family_identity: Apply evaluation_family_overrides before all counts and partitions; aliases, clones, and pre/post pairs remain one family

activation_floor.rationale: The 40-label/eight-family floor matches Phase 4 descriptive maturity, while two separately frozen prediction waves prevent one acquisition event from being described as chronological depth.

acquisition_sequence: Freeze a dated training cutoff, effective family-distinct training-label digest, model/scoring identity, and untouched source-selection inputs before scanning or scoring.
Acquire genuinely new product-repository findings without using security outcomes, classifier scores, or target paths as source-selection inputs.
Persist compatible predictions and exact timestamps before selecting any review packet.
Freeze a bounded outcome-blind packet across independent evaluation families and preserve abstention.
Import explicit analyst outcomes only after every reviewed prediction identity and timestamp are verified unchanged.
Repeat with a second separately frozen prediction wave; never backdate, rescore, or pool an outcome-known score as prospective evidence.
After the activation floor passes, report fixed-threshold precision, recall, Brier score, class counts, family counts, and family-block uncertainty without selecting a production threshold.
fail_closed_rules: Exclude any finding whose outcome, assessment, label, falsification verdict, or answer key was known before its prediction was frozen.
Exclude any score produced by a model trained on that finding's label or on a later label relative to the declared cutoff.
Do not treat repeated scoring, rescoring, aliases, clones, or related pre/post snapshots as additional temporal waves or families.
If either class, 40 decided labels, eight families, or two prediction waves is missing, retain the evidence but keep OPT-003 data-gated.
Do not tune, retrain, recalibrate, select a threshold, or change detection rules using an incomplete temporal evaluation wave.

authorization_boundary.next_approval: A separate acquisition receipt must freeze the first new wave's sources, commits, model-training cutoff and digest, scoring identity, commands, selection contract, resource ceilings, and every network/provider boundary.
